title.narrative: {Consortium} Strengthening Food Security and Resilience through Integrated FSL, Health, Nutrition, and WASH services in Conflict-Affected Al-Nuhud, West Kordofan, Sudan

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project, Provision of Integrated Lifesaving Responses to Populations Affected by Displacement and Food Insecurity in Al-Nuhud, West Kordofan, addresses critical humanitarian needs in conflict-affected localities. It integrates Health, Nutrition, WASH, and FSL services, targeting 93,852 individuals, including displaced persons, host communities, and vulnerable groups. The project aligns with the HRP’s lifesaving response priorities and seeks to mitigate mortality and morbidity through comprehensive, multi-sectoral interventions.ltbrgtltbrgtUnder health, the project targets to address the health needs of 17,000 people including 4,000 internally displaced people in An Nuhud locality in West Kordofan. This will be accomplished through supporting one fixed primary health care center called Althawra. The package of primary health care will include outpatient consultations (for both communicable and non-communicable diseases), provision of reproductive health (including ANC, safe delivery, PNC, FP), EPI services, mental health and psychosocial support, referral and provision medicines. Alight expects to have a team of seconded staff providing care.ltbrgtUnder nutrition, Alight will address gaps in accessing nutrition services for the same community through one nutrition site at Althawra. The package will include MUAC screening for early detection of malnourished children, provision of treatment services through TSFP and OTP while cases requiring stabilization centers, caregivers will be supported with transport cost. Additionally, as part of prevention, Alight will promote and support IYCN by integrating IYCN in health and nutrition services and by establishing supporting mother support groups.ltbrgtFSL interventions, jointly implemented by LM International and AORD, focus on agricultural recovery and resilience-building. The project provides agricultural inputs such as seeds, tools, and livestock to vulnerable households, along with veterinary services to improve animal health. Training on sustainable farming practices, including crop selection, pest management, and post-harvest handling, enhances productivity and economic stability. These efforts support livelihood recovery and reduce dependence on external assistance.ltbrgtWASH activities, also implemented by LM International and AORD, aim to enhance access to clean water and improve sanitation and hygiene. Key activities include rehabilitating water points, constructing gender-sensitive sanitation facilities, and distributing hygiene kits. Hygiene promotion campaigns encourage practices such as handwashing, water treatment, and proper sanitation, reducing the risk of waterborne diseases. Water management committees are established and trained to sustain WASH infrastructure.ltbrgtThe consortium operates as a cohesive unit, ensuring synergy across sectors. WASH activities, such as water point rehabilitation and hygiene promotion, directly support health and nutrition outcomes through reduced risk of waterborne diseases and access to clean water for food preparation and consumption. FSL activities, including livestock restocking and agricultural training, enhance food security and reduce malnutrition risks, directly supporting health and nutrition objectives. Regular coordination meetings facilitate joint planning, alignment, and problem-solving, fostering seamless integration of activities.ltbrgtCapacity-building initiatives, including training healthcare workers, establishing water management committees, and providing agricultural skills training, ensure sustainability and community ownership beyond the project period. Fostering strong local partnerships, engaging stakeholders, and leveraging the synergy between sectors maximizes project impact and builds resilience. Through its integrated, collaborative approach, the consortium delivers timely and impactful responses, addressing urgent needs while laying the groundwork for sustainable recovery and resilience in Al-Nuhud, West Kordofan.ltbrgtlt/pgt
